title: subagent: a child runs under the parent's config, named by EIDOLON_CONFIG
why: A host that starts eidolon with `--config <file>` (Minerva's perch: ~/Minerva/config.toml, or config-manual.toml in manual mode) gets children that run under ~/.config/eidolon/config.toml instead: spawn.rn passes `--config` only under a call budget, and then copies from the XDG default. So a child escapes the host's policy, guard rows and sessions dir. eidolon has no way to tell a plugin which config it runs under, so the host says it in the environment, which plugin shells inherit (EIDOLON_BIN already works this way). The operator decided: children get the parent's config via env. eidolon itself reads no EIDOLON_CONFIG (checked: no such name in eidolon's source).
what:
subagent/tools/spawn.rn, and every other subagent/tools/*.rn that runs `eidolon`:
- EIDOLON_CONFIG, when set and not empty, names the parent's config. It must be an absolute path to a readable regular file (after following links); anything else refuses the spawn with one sentence naming the variable and what is wrong, and starts nothing. Unset or empty: today's behaviour exactly (the XDG default).
- No budget: with EIDOLON_CONFIG set, the child gets `--config <that file>`. Unset: no --config (as today).
- A budget: PREP_SH copies from EIDOLON_CONFIG when set (else the XDG default, as today). When EIDOLON_CONFIG is set and the copy cannot read it, refuse (today an unreadable source silently yields a config holding only max_iterations, i.e. eidolon's defaults: with a named parent config that is a policy escape).
- The child's environment: EIDOLON_CONFIG is exported as the config the child actually runs with (the budget copy, or the parent's file), and unset when the child gets no --config.
- Every other `eidolon` call the plugin makes (pick.rn's `eidolon models`, the catalog in spawn.rn, list.rn, trace, steer, cancel, plan: find each) passes `--config <EIDOLON_CONFIG>` when it is set, so the model list and the listings come from the config the parent runs under. List every call site you changed and every one you left, with why.
- meta_lines' `config=` records the config the child was given (empty when none), as today.
- README (subagent/README.md): an EIDOLON_CONFIG section beside the EIDOLON_BIN one: who sets it (a host that starts eidolon with --config), what the plugin does with it, the refusal sentence, and that the budget copy lives in another directory, so a relative path inside the parent's config would resolve against the copy's directory (Minerva's generated configs use absolute paths). Check commands in the README's existing style.
- The nested-subagent refusal (EIDOLON_SUBAGENT) and the EIDOLON_BIN rules are unchanged.
owns_files: tests/README.md (a row, if the file exists)
tests: tests/subagent/*.sh in the style of tests/jev/*.sh (read them and tests/ first). PREP_SH and CHILD_SH are shell text inside Rune constants: a test may extract them from the .rn file (as text, with the Rune string escapes undone) and run them under sh, or reproduce the decision in a sourced helper the .rn and the test share if the plugin's layout allows; say which and why. Cases: EIDOLON_CONFIG unset (byte-identical behaviour to before: same --config decision, same copy source); set to an absolute regular file (no budget: --config is it; budget: the copy's body is max_iterations then that file's lines minus its top-level max_iterations); set to a relative path, a directory, a missing file, an unreadable file, a dangling link (each refused with the sentence, nothing written beyond the state dir); empty (same as unset). A fake eidolon (EIDOLON_BIN at a script) records argv for the catalog/models calls: with EIDOLON_CONFIG set they carry --config. Every test runs under a temp HOME with XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR inside it.
live_check: None: a real spawn needs swarm on and a model, and the operator's rule is swarm off and no model calls. If you run the real eidolon at all, it is $HOME/.local/bin/eidolon under the temp HOME above, swarm off, no model call (for example `eidolon --config <file> plugins list` to confirm the plugin still loads, if a plugin dir can be pointed at the worktree without touching ~/.config/eidolon).
risk: Fail closed: a set but bad EIDOLON_CONFIG refuses; never fall back to the XDG default when the variable is set. Unset must change nothing for people who run eidolon without a host.
